sites.evidence_note: Border-control node mapped in March 2020 is a vertex of the named Kharlachi Border Crossing area, way 1466971322. It locates the road crossing, not Kharlachi village or the nearby Borki route. The Foreign Ministry’s 17 June 2017 notice identifies the Kharlachi Kurram crossing for trade/transit vehicles, and the 2017–18 Planning Commission yearbook records NLC establishing its terminal in that period. Together with the original July 2018 notice naming this crossing and the road-gate location, this supports a crossing-area reference; no exact 2018 terminal-building footprint is claimed.
